data.one_liner: Preview local and remote files with inline viewers and external app fallbacks in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter widget to preview common file types including images, videos, PDFs, spreadsheets, and text documents. It supports both local files and remote URLs, automatically downloading remote files and falling back to external apps for unsupported formats.
use_when: You need to display inline previews of documents or media within your Flutter app.
You want to handle both local file paths and remote URLs using a single widget.
You need a fallback option to open unsupported files using external applications.
avoid_when: You require complex editing capabilities for documents or spreadsheets.
You need inline preview for PowerPoint files (which currently only support external app fallback).
strengths: Supports multiple file types like images, videos, PDFs, Word, spreadsheets, and markdown.
Handles remote URLs by downloading files to temporary storage automatically.
Includes external app fallback for unsupported formats.
weaknesses: PowerPoint files currently lack inline preview and rely on external fallbacks.
Legacy `.doc` files are not supported inline and fall back to external apps.
